sourceSentences: [0] En fase de línea Braum puede ser molesto debido a que su E le sirve para parar la mayor parte de su daño proveniente de la Q de Karma.
[0] His shield (and tanky body) negates your poke, but it has a long cooldown.
[0] Be careful with 2 things: 1 - His passive Concussive Blows, is too dangerous. 2 - His E block your Mantra Q.
[0] Not very useful into you, just poke them down. Don't stand too close to enemy minion or he can w to minion and all in.
[0] Care about, not standing near one of HIS Minions. Else poke him low with Q's and aa's

[0] He can't really do anything to you, but just be aware that if you R-Q him, and he shields it, you will not get any Mantra cooldown back (because it blocks 100% of the damage of the first thing that hits it)
[0] Tome cuidado com a passiva dele, sempre saia de perto quando ele acertar o poke dele para o adc inimigo não te estunar.
[1] Make sure you’re always stood behind the minion wave so Karma cannot use her Inner Flame(Q) on you. Stand behind the minions but not close to them as her Q is an AOE ability.
[1] Karma has her Ultimate Mantra(R) at level 1, so she will be quite strong up until level 6.
[1] Karma doesn't really threaten Braum. Sure, her Mantra'd Q hurts, but it's inconsistent and you should be able to block or dodge it fairly easily.
[1] high poke and shield, dont expect to win extended poke fights. Her shield gives MS, making it easier for opponents do dodge glasc q and r.
[1] Not only does she have a movement speed buff and shield, but it can also be used on her ADC. This gives her decent disengage and mobility with which she can dodge your ult and Q.
[1] Karma will definitely poke you out of lane, so be careful for that. When you manage to stay healthy in lane, you can try to engage.
